title: Volleyball: San Sebastian turns back EAC in 5-set marathon
summary: San Sebastian College-Recoletos pulled off a reverse sweep of Emilio Aguinaldo College in the 2026 Shakey's Super League (SSL) Unity Cup behind the heroics of team captain Juna Gonzales.
